storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard. Opened: close tightly and keep in the fridge; always use a dry, clean spoon. Use within the time the label gives after opening (typically a few weeks). Throw it out if mould appears or it smells off.
looksLike: A thick, oily, brick-red to bright-orange paste of chopped red chilli, garlic and other seasonings, sold in glass or plastic jars.
shelfLife: Unopened, until the date on the jar (usually several months).
substitutes: Red chilli-garlic sauce plus a little soy sauce and vinegar

usedIn.raw: 25 g (1½ tbsp); Jain variant uses 25 g Jain Schezwan chutney instead; the lighter variant uses 17 g (1 tbsp)
